comp6.title: Seminars
comp6.description: Seminars and webinars connect learners with experts from academia, industry and the international space community. Topics span GNSS antennas, spoofing mitigation, receiver design, satellite technology, careers, curriculum, public engagement and emerging space applications.

comp7.title: Conferences
comp7.description: The lab contributes to national and international conferences through technical papers, thematic sessions, panel discussions, demonstrations and research networking. The Position, Navigation and Timing track at ICAST 2025 provided a focused platform for research exchange across GNSS, ionospheric science and navigation technologies.
